annotations.text:
DB CheckOut — Spanish-first crew app, wired to JobTread.
Top: how it connects to the JT Production board & JT Forms.
This row, left to right: job queue → job home → inspection checklist → report a problem (photo + voice ES/EN → English note) → cleanup checklist → send to JobTread.
Customers & addresses are sample data; PM names and statuses come from your JobTread.

Punch crew flow — same app. The PM assigns repairs on the JT Production board; the crew sees where to go, what to do, what to bring, and checks off each repair with before/after photos. When the last repair closes, the job auto-moves to Punch Review; the PM approves the photos and sets Job Completed.

The ES·EN pill now sits on every inspection & punch screen. This is the same inspection checklist with EN selected — every label flips priority (English big, español small; BIEN becomes OK, FALLA becomes FIX). Each crew member's choice is remembered on their phone.

PM side — the desktop Production Board (far right) is the PM's main surface, synced with JT statuses; the four phone screens are the same tools on the go. Crew notes arrive as drafts: the PM edits the English note into the work order before assigning — the crew gets it in Spanish + English. Approvals write to JobTread: task closed, status advanced. A report can also be dismissed as no-action-needed with a reason — its photo & note stay on the JT job as documentation.
